requirements.statement: Deep collection serialization must use immutable append-only generations: concurrent collectors share one terminal result, a dead owner may advance, and a live or stale owner cannot alter a newer generation.

advances beyond a provably dead immutable collector owner without deleting it
does not steal a live long-running collector owner
an ABA stale generation cannot affect a newer live collector

bindings.test: publishes one exact completion event only after the durable Deep result and report
a collector that waited for a terminal result finalizes its missing event without transport
a wait-null follower rereads and finalizes a result published in that gap
fails closed for malformed, symlinked, or different preexisting completion events
